query_plan.query: What is the average area of countries in square kilometers?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by country id, calculate the average area.
steps.query: Return all countries together with their area, with their country id and country name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT AVG(area_km2) AS avg_area FROM countries

s1.sql_query: SELECT countries.country, countries.name, countries.area_km2 FROM countries
